title: CleanProof: quality inspections and client reports for cleaning companies
source: Top 25 SaaS ideas for Victor (research report, Nov 2026)
summary: Supervisors inspect cleaning with phone photos and scores, and AI writes the monthly quality report the client actually reads. Built for cleaning firms with 5–60 sites that find bigger systems too heavy.
hook: "The client says the office is dirty. I know my team was there every night, but I have nothing to show them."
story:
**Anders owns a cleaning company in Gothenburg with 40 staff and 25 office sites.** His area manager walks through sites with a paper checklist and takes photos on her own phone. The photos stay on her phone.

When a facility manager complains, Anders has **no clear record** of what was checked and when. At contract renewal, a cheaper competitor shows up with a nice-looking report, and Anders has only a spreadsheet. He does not want a big system that takes months to set up; he wants **proof of quality, sent to the client every month**, without extra office work.
whyNow: Bigger systems are too heavy for mid-sized cleaners: Aspire is aimed at mid-size to enterprise firms with a claimed 6–12 month setup for 100+ sites (a competitor's claim). AI can now turn photos and scores into a readable report automatically. There is no regulatory deadline.
evidence: Swept starts at about $77/month by number of locations (unverified), with 4.3 stars from 79 reviews [Capterra]
SafetyCulture Premium costs $24 per user per month for general inspections [SafetyCulture]
Aspire is aimed at mid-size to enterprise firms with a claimed 6–12 month setup for 100+ sites (claim from competitor SweepOps) [SweepOps]
Pain evidence is weak: lost contracts from missing proof of quality is an inference from Jonatan's industry, not a measured fact [Top 25 report]

whyReal.title: Quality is hard to prove
whyReal.text: Cleaning happens at night when nobody watches. Without photos and scores, a complaint is the client's word against the cleaner's.

whyReal.title: People already pay for inspection tools
whyReal.text: Swept, SafetyCulture, CleanTelligent and Janitorial Manager all charge for inspections, so willingness to pay exists.

whyReal.title: The report is the missing piece
whyReal.text: Existing tools collect data. A short, well-written monthly report for the client, with photos, is what helps at contract renewal.

whyReal.title: Jonatan knows this world
whyReal.text: It is the same buyer as SubDocs (facility-services firms), so one sales call can open two products.

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: Commercial cleaning and facility-services companies with 10–100 staff and 5–60 sites.

whoPays.label: Start market
whoPays.text: The Nordics through Jonatan's network, then other English-speaking markets.

solution.title: Build a checklist
solution.text: pick a template (office, restroom, kitchen) and adjust it per site.

solution.title: Inspect on the phone
solution.text: the supervisor walks the site, gives scores and takes photos in a mobile web app.

solution.title: QR feedback
solution.text: each site gets a "rate this restroom" QR code so building users can report problems.

solution.title: Issue tickets
solution.text: low scores and complaints become tasks assigned to a cleaner.

solution.title: AI monthly report
solution.text: AI turns scores, photos and fixed issues into a short PDF/email report per client.

solution.title: Client portal
solution.text: the client can see inspections and reports in a read-only view.

must: Mobile inspections with photos and scores
AI-written monthly PDF/email report per client
later: Bundle with SubDocs for the same customers
Swedish and other Nordic languages in reports

timeline.what: **Validate, no code.** Jonatan offers 5 Nordic cleaning firms a free monthly quality report built by hand from their photos (Google Forms + ChatGPT). Measure whether their clients react, and whether firms will pay €59/month to keep it.
Victor builds checklists, mobile inspections with photos and the QR feedback page.
Issue tickets, AI monthly report and client portal; login and Stripe.
Move the pilot firms to the product; offer it to SubDocs prospects as a second product.

risks.answer: Focus on the client report and the Nordic network; sell as a second product to SubDocs customers.

risks.risk: Weak AI advantage, easy to copy
risks.answer: Win on speed to set up, local relationships and bundling, not on AI alone.
Keep a flat, simple price and show that one saved contract pays for years.

questions: How do you prove cleaning quality to clients today?
When did you last lose or nearly lose a contract over quality complaints?
Who does inspections, how often, and with what tools?
How long does monthly client reporting take?
What software have you tried, and why did it stick or not?
